nodes.label: Distance between two points
nodes.description: Calculate the distance between two points on the coordinate plane using the distance rule (including points on an axis and the distance from the origin).

nodes.label: Prove shapes using distances
nodes.description: Use side and diagonal lengths found with the distance rule to prove that four points are the vertices of a parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus or square, or that a triangle is right angled (converse of the Pythagorean theorem), and calculate its area.

nodes.label: Collinear points and circle
nodes.description: Use distances to show that three points are collinear (the sum of two distances equals the third) or that points lie on a circle with a given center (equal distances).

nodes.label: Midpoint from the figure
nodes.description: Find the two coordinates of the midpoint of a straight segment parallel to an axis, or from a drawing, given its two ends.

nodes.label: Calculate midpoint coordinates
nodes.description: Calculate the coordinates of the midpoint of a straight segment given its two ends, using M((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2), the average of the coordinates.

nodes.label: Find missing end point
nodes.description: Determine the coordinates of an end point of a segment, or the fourth vertex of a parallelogram (and the intersection of its diagonals), given the midpoint, by solving the midpoint formula for the unknown.

nodes.label: Slope from points or angle
nodes.description: Calculate the slope of a straight line from two points, and from the positive angle it makes with the positive direction of the x-axis using m = tan E, and find the angle from a given slope with the calculator.

nodes.label: Parallel lines and slopes
nodes.description: Use equal slopes to prove that two straight lines are parallel and to find unknown coordinates for lines parallel to an axis.

nodes.label: Perpendicular lines and slopes
nodes.description: Use the product of slopes equal to -1 to prove two straight lines are perpendicular, and to find a missing slope or coordinate.

nodes.label: Slope and y-intercept from equation
nodes.description: Determine the slope and the length of the y-intercept of a straight line from its equation, by writing it in the form y = mx + b or using m = -a/b, and use them to represent the line graphically.

nodes.label: Find equation of a line
nodes.description: Find the equation of a straight line in the form y = mx + b, given its slope (found from two points, a perpendicular line, or a bisected segment's mid-point) and a point on it.
